finalText.titleDe: Lösungswege für Klammer- und Verhältnisgleichungen vergleichen
finalText.titleEn: Compare solution methods for bracketed and ratio equations
finalText.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann nach dem Lösen einer linearen Klammergleichung und einer Verhältnisgleichung die jeweils tragende Struktur – Distributivgesetz beziehungsweise Proportionalität mit zulässigen Nennern – erläutern, Gemeinsamkeiten und Unterschiede der zulässigen Umformungen vergleichen und die erhaltenen Lösungen durch Einsetzen in die jeweilige Ausgangsgleichung prüfen.
finalText.descriptionEn: After solving a bracketed linear equation and a ratio equation, the learner can explain the governing structure in each case—the distributive law or proportionality with admissible denominators—compare similarities and differences in the admissible transformations, and check the obtained solutions by substituting them into the respective original equation.

decisions.title: Laufzeit tabellarisch näherungsweise bestimmen
decisions.description: Die lernende Person kann mit einer Tabellenkalkulation die Laufzeit in einfachen Finanzsituationen als Anzahl der Zins- oder Zahlungsperioden näherungsweise bestimmen und das Ergebnis im Kontext prüfen.
decisions.reason: Complete compositional support: interest, capital and rate with variable time/periods; periodic capital growth; spreadsheet cells/formulas and systematic parameter variation; solving by trial and context checking. For duration, enumerate successive periods and bracket first attainment. For rate, hold other inputs fixed and vary/bracket the percentage. Neither goal requires an annuity formula or an independent regular-payment model. Do not infer either target from the current prerequisite chain.
decisions.affectedRebaseLosses: HE-G8 and RP-G8/G9; retain the same already-authored HE-G9 target disposition.

decisions.title: Tilgung oder Sparrate tabellarisch näherungsweise bestimmen
decisions.description: Die lernende Person kann mit einer Tabellenkalkulation einen regelmäßigen Tilgungsbetrag oder eine regelmäßige Sparrate für ein vorgegebenes Finanzziel näherungsweise bestimmen und anhand der berechneten Restschuld- oder Guthabenentwicklung im Kontext prüfen.
decisions.reason: The entire contract requires constructing and varying a regular repayment/savings amount, interpreting the full debt/balance path, and transferring between differently structured repayment and saving contexts. Interest/percentages and general spreadsheet use show mathematical feasibility but do not establish that additional recurring-payment model as a required whole competency. RP mentions different saving forms as a teaching hint; it does not substantiate the complete repayment-to-saving transfer contract. No claim is made that the mathematics or canonical goal is invalid.
decisions.disposition: Remove direct/inherited S1 target claims consistently in HE and RP combined and pure-S1 G8/G9 scopes, including the still-present HE-G9 occurrences and generic HE combined source branches. Preserve stable canonical definition, mastery and actual prerequisite support; do not move to SII without separate source support. Direct support-role masking may prevent broad branches from reintroducing it. No requires restoration or canonical goal change is authorized.

decisions.title: Aufgabe 4 (Jahrgangsstufe 8, 6 BE)
decisions.description: Die lernende Person kann eine freigegebene Prüfungsaufgabe der Jahrgangsstufe 8 bearbeiten: Bruchterme formal sauber umformen, Variableneinschränkungen angeben und eine Bruchformel nach einer Variablen auflösen.
decisions.reason: The supplied task demands same-denominator addition, elementary multiplication/division and cancellation with nonzero conditions, rearranging an explicitly positive physical formula, and a simple fractional equation. Each is within the supported formal term/equation and formula contract; no hidden external method is needed. The six HE additions are therefore authorized from task content and source, not from the shortened requires list.
decisions.yearBoundary: Stage-level acceptance only. Canonical title J8 is not proof of compulsory Hessian J8 acquisition: the full mandatory simple-fractional-equation sequencing evidence occurs by J9; the older J8 material includes optional fraction entries. No new official J8 attainment claim is granted.

decisions.title: Aufgabe 1 (Jahrgangsstufe 10, 10 BE)
decisions.description: Die lernende Person kann eine freigegebene Prüfungsaufgabe der Jahrgangsstufe 10 bearbeiten: Exponentialmodelle, Logarithmen, Halbwertszeit, Asymptotik und Zinseszins im Kontext deuten.
decisions.reason: The complete task uses given exponential models: parameter interpretation, decreasing graph and horizontal asymptote, function values, logarithmic threshold/half-life, and compound-interest terminology/value. The source explicitly includes capital growth/decay models, these graph properties and exponential equations by logarithms with half-life/doubling examples. All three RP-G9 additions are authorized; no new RP-G8 assessment selection follows.
